sentences.text: Texas -LRB- -LSB- ˈtɛksəs -RSB- , -LSB- localˈtɛksᵻz -RSB- Texas or Tejas -LSB- ˈtexas -RSB- -RRB- is the second largest state in the United States by both area and population .	state	U.S. state	United States	United States	area	List of U.S. states and territories by area	population	List of U.S. states and territories by population

Geographically located in the South Central region of the country , Texas shares borders with the U.S. states of Louisiana to the east , Arkansas to the northeast , Oklahoma to the north , New Mexico to the west , and the Mexican states of Chihuahua , Coahuila , Nuevo León , and Tamaulipas to the southwest , while the Gulf of Mexico is to the southeast . Houston is the most populous city in Texas and the fourth largest in the U.S. , while San Antonio is the second most populous in the state and seventh largest in the U.S. Dallas -- Fort Worth and Greater Houston are the fourth and fifth largest metropolitan statistical areas in the country , respectively . Texas is nicknamed `` The Lone Star State '' to signify its former status as an independent republic , and as a reminder of the state 's struggle for independence from Mexico .	state	U.S. state	Mexico	Mexico
The `` Lone Star '' can be found on the Texan state flag and on the Texan state seal .	Texan	Texan (disambiguation)	state	U.S. state
The origin of Texas 's name is from the word `` Tejas , '' which means `` friends '' in the Caddo language .	Caddo	Caddo

Due to its size and geologic features such as the Balcones Fault , Texas contains diverse landscapes that resemble both the U.S. Southern and Southwestern regions .	Balcones Fault	Balcones Fault	landscapes	Geography of Texas	Southern	Southern United States
